author: ocean state today
title: Providence College volleyball adds transfer Sarah Musial to 2026 roster
text:
Providence College volleyball Head Coach Margot Royer-Johnson announced on May 13 that redshirt sophomore Sarah Musial has committed to join the program and will compete for the Friars beginning in the fall of 2026.
The addition of Musial brings experience and depth to the Providence College women’s volleyball team as they prepare for upcoming seasons.
“We are so excited to welcome Sarah to the Friar Family,” Royer-Johnson said. “We know she will make an immediate impact for us! She is a well-trained setter who leads by example. She has a quick release and fast feet. Sarah’s a gritty player who puts everything into her game and works to win. We could not be happier that she is a Friar!”
Musial, standing at six-foot-one, transferred from Wichita State University where she played in 13 matches during her rookie season with the Shockers. Over those appearances, she recorded 87 assists and averaged 3.22 assists per set. Before college, Musial attended St. Charles East High School where she was a three-year letterwinner, starter, captain as a senior, and earned All-State honors as a junior. She also competed at club level for Sports Performance.
The team looks forward to integrating Musial’s skills into their lineup as they build toward future competitions.
